subtitle.text: Get away from the river. Find a way through the farms.

ledger.text: Private Reyes (radio): “You alive? …Good. Don't stop moving. That thing doesn't sleep.”
Private Reyes (radio): “It can't fit where you fit. Use that.”
Private Reyes (radio, breaking up): “…the hangar… they're still there… lights on…”
Dr. Elena Voss: "You're the courier. The one from the Annex."
Voss: "The sample you carried that morning came from here. We sent it to the Annex for testing. The container failed. That's on us. Not on you."
Courier: "I carried it."
Voss: "Then carry this one."

Voss: "It's airborne. It doesn't kill them — it brings them back. Whoever is still in there. The dispersal complex is two kilometres east. Plug it into the main console, hold it while it charges, and release it."
Sergeant Ruiz: "Your weapons came off the bridge wreck this morning. Cleaned them. Took the liberty."
Voss: "Prototype. Burns hot. Don't use it in the corn."
Private Reyes: "I'm coming."
Voss: "You're bleeding into my floor. You're staying."
Private Reyes: "Go finish your delivery."
